author: CodeWithHarry
description:
In this video, we build a complete AI Powered E-Commerce Website using MongoDB Atlas, React, Node.js, Express, and AI powered search capabilities.

We will cover:
- Authentication
- Product management
- Shopping cart & orders
- MongoDB Atlas
- AI powered semantic search
- Vector Search
- Embeddings
- Real-world scalable architecture

This video is sponsored by MongoDB.

MongoDB is the database for modern applications and the AI era. With MongoDB Atlas, developers can build scalable apps with integrated search, vector search, and AI capabilities without managing complex infrastructure.
